story: US-001 — View and Edit Profile Information

existing_endpoints_reviewed.rationale: Already returns user data; add ProfileDto projection to expose only the four profile fields.
Administrative full-update endpoint; must not be used for profile edits to enforce field-level restrictions.
Bulk listing; not relevant to profile management.

new_endpoints.rationale: Narrowly-scoped endpoint accepting only { name }. Owns validation, XSS sanitisation, audit logging, and email notification.

database_changes.notes: Existing columns (name, email, registration_date, account_status) satisfy requirements. Only 'name' is mutable via the profile endpoint.
Requires columns: id, user_id (FK), field, old_value, new_value, changed_at, ip_address, user_agent. Create migration if table absent.

decision: Enhance existing GET endpoint with a ProfileDto projection and create a new PATCH /api/users/{id}/profile endpoint for name updates.

non_functional_requirements.audit_logging: Insert into audit_logs on every successful name change
non_functional_requirements.email_notification: Async dispatch after successful DB write

risks.risk: Email service unavailable at update time
risks.mitigation: Use async queue with retry; do not block HTTP response
Enforce server-side encoding; add integration test
